now.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
now.text: Riri's vibranium detector makes her Namor's target, and Shuri and Okoye bring her to Wakanda. She builds a suit and fights for Wakanda against Talokan, then goes back to MIT without it.
cases: ST-104 The Battle on the Atlantic (Black Panther: Wakanda Forever)

proposed.text: Riri's vibranium detector makes her Namor's target, and his warriors take her and Shuri to Talokan until Nakia frees them. She builds a suit and fights for Wakanda against Talokan, then goes back to MIT without it.

changes.evidence: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever: after Shuri and Okoye find Riri at MIT, Namor's warriors defeat Okoye and take Shuri and Riri underwater to Talokan; Nakia later helps Shuri and Riri escape. Shuri and Okoye do not bring her to Wakanda.

proposed.text: Namor's warriors ambush Riri on the bridge, and Namora and Attuma throw her suit into the water below.

changes.evidence: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever: Riri survives the chase and regroups with Shuri and Okoye on the bridge; the Talokanil ambush them, knock Riri out, and Namora and Attuma throw her armor into the water to hide the evidence. The chase itself does not wreck it, and it is thrown away, not destroyed.
